{# sphinx_rtd_theme-only override (this directory is added to templates_path in conf.py only when docs_theme == "rtd"). sphinx_rtd_theme renders only `project` as the sidebar home link, and 3.x additionally dropped the separate version line that used to sit beneath it (the `display_version` option was removed; the version now only appears in the Read the Docs-hosted flyout, which these GitHub Pages builds don't have). Render the version inline instead, so the header reads "Omnistat (v1.14.0)" as it did before the theme port. `project` itself is left alone because it also feeds the page titles and the footer copyright. This reproduces the theme's own sidebartitle block (layout.html) rather than calling super(), since the change is inside that block. Re-check against the theme if sphinx_rtd_theme is upgraded. #} {% extends "!layout.html" %} {%- block sidebartitle %} {%- set _logo_url = logo_url|default(pathto('_static/' + (logo or ""), 1)) %} {%- set _root_doc = root_doc|default(master_doc) %} {% if not theme_logo_only %}{{ project }}{% if version %} (v{{ version }}){% endif %}{% endif %} {%- if logo or logo_url %} {%- endif %} {%- include "searchbox.html" %} {%- endblock %}
